service_org_legal_entity.quote: We have examined Daily, Co.'s ("Daily") accompanying description of its system titled "Daily's Description of its Video and Audio API Platform throughout the period April 14, 2025 to July 14, 2025"
service_org_legal_entity.note: Cover (p1) and section headers render the entity as 'Daily, Co.' / 'DAILY, CO.' — WITH a comma before 'Co.'. This matches the filename form 'Daily, Co.'. Assertion is titled 'Assertion of the Management of Daily, Co.' (p2).

auditor_firm.note: Signature block at the end of the Independent Service Auditors' Report.

report_period.quote: Suitability of the Design and Operating Effectiveness of Controls Relevant to Security and Confidentiality Throughout the Period April 14, 2025 to July 14, 2025 (Type 2)

soc2_type.quote: Throughout the Period April 14, 2025 to July 14, 2025 (Type 2) SOC 2 - SOC for Service Organizations: Trust Services Criteria

trust_services_criteria.quote: Trust Services Criteria relevant to security and confidentiality ("applicable Trust Services Criteria") set forth in TSP section 100

3.1.1.quote: All data transmitted between the Company and the users of the System is protected using transport layer security (TLS) and HTTP strict transport security (HSTS), where applicable.

supporting_quotes.quote: has a valid certificate and only accepts TLS connections using up-to-date cipher suites.

3.1.1.notes: TLS is stated but NO version number (1.2/1.3) is given anywhere in the report, so no exact dropdown match. Real language: 'transport layer security (TLS) and HTTP strict transport security (HSTS)' with 'up-to-date cipher suites'.

3.1.2.quote: Data stores housing sensitive customer data are encrypted at rest. Inspected the configuration of AWS to verify that AWS S3 buckets containing user data are encrypted at rest.

supporting_quotes.quote: Inspected the configuration of OCI to verify that all block volumes are encrypted at rest.

3.1.2.notes: Encryption at rest is attested (S3, DynamoDB, RDS, OCI block volumes) but the report never names an algorithm/standard (no AES-128/192/256 anywhere), so no exact dropdown match.

3.1.4.quote: Cryptographic keys are managed throughout their life cycle (e.g., ownership, generation, storage, distribution, periodic rotation, and revocation) in accordance with key management procedures.

supporting_quotes.quote: Privileged access to encryption keys is restricted to authorized users with a business need.

3.1.4.notes: The report states Daily owns/generates/manages keys per its key management procedures. It does NOT state whether keys are customer-specific; 'not customer-specific' is the default reading (no customer-managed-key offering is described) — flag for reviewer.

3.1.6.quote: Daily stores anonymized call logs and metrics in order to improve the quality of its service and help troubleshoot customer reported issues. No PII is collected along with this call information.
3.1.6.notes: Evidence is limited to anonymization of call logs/metrics; the report does not describe a general capability to anonymize customer personal data on request.

3.1.8.value:
Multi-factor authentication (MFA) required for access to environments containing customer data
Privileged access to encryption keys restricted to authorized users with a business need
Full-disk encryption enforced on employee computers via MDM
Data replication and snapshots for backup; backup-recovery restore exercises performed
Continuous security monitoring of critical infrastructure (incl. AWS CloudTrail/GuardDuty)
Annual review of AWS and OCI SOC 2 reports (subservice oversight)
3.1.8.quote: Access to environments that contain customer data requires a series of authentication and authorization controls, including multi-factor authentication (MFA).

3.2.1.quote: AWS infrastructure supporting Daily's video and audio calling are located in: ... Europe (Frankfurt), Europe (London) ... Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) ... Europe (Frankfurt), Europe (London)
3.2.1.notes: Signaling/media run in AWS and OCI regions that include Europe (Frankfurt, London); the web server is listed only as US West (Oregon). Subservice organizations AWS and OCI are carved out (carve-out method, p9); Daily is responsible for configuring them (p14). The report makes no GDPR/EU-data-residency commitment — it only lists regions.

absent: 3.1.3 backup encryption — backups are described only as 'data replication and snapshots' with restricted access (p18); the report never states that backups are encrypted or names a standard.
3.1.7 pseudonymization — the word 'pseudonym' does not appear in the report; no pseudonymization capability described.
TLS version number — TLS is named but never versioned (relevant to 3.1.1).
At-rest algorithm — 'encrypted at rest' attested but no AES/algorithm named (relevant to 3.1.2).
Customer-specific vs shared key statement (relevant to 3.1.4).
End-to-end encryption statement across the whole processing cycle (relevant to 3.1.5).
